text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Heart Disease, specifically an Atrial Septal Defect (ASD) with right heart failure.

The Echocardiogram confirms an Atrial Septal Defect with a left-to-right shunt, which explains the rapid breathing and sinus tachycardia due to volume overload. The enlarged cardiac silhouette seen on the Chest X-ray is consistent with right ventricular hypertrophy and dilation from this defect, while the normal metabolic and kidney panels rule out other causes for your fluid retention and edema.
